name: @caistech/planning-memory
description: The experiential (Mnemo) leg of the planning-retrieval hybrid — recall + store DISTILLED, jurisdiction-general planning CONCLUSIONS in a SHARED, state-keyed scope (caistech-planning-<state>), so per-state retrieval depth compounds across every consuming product. Never the citation layer (DATA_STANDARD D1/D2 — that stays OWNED RAG); stores only distilled, non-PII interpretation (I4/S4). Zero-dep (native fetch), env-driven (MNEMO_API_KEY), fail-soft. Consumed by F2K-Checkpoint (planning review) + DealFindrs (viability).
